name: Firefox Pause
description: Pauses Firefox media when you pass a chosen percent in a level.

toggle-keybind.name: Toggle keybind
toggle-keybind.description: Press this key to turn Firefox Pause on or off while playing.

percent.name: Pause at percent (current level)
percent.description: Percent at which Firefox pauses in the level you're playing. It's remembered separately for each level.

default-percent.name: Default percent (new levels)
default-percent.description: Used for levels you haven't set a percent for yet.

port.name: Helper UDP port
port.description: Must match the port used by the Linux helper script.
